newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Rise of US dollar could help EU growth-de Silguy.
newsitem.headline: Rise of US dollar could help EU growth-de Silguy.

text.p: European monetary affairs commissioner Yves Thibault de Silguy said on Tuesday that the recent appreciation of the dollar could be positive for European Union-wide economic growth this year.
But it was unclear what effect an even higher dollar would have, he told the European Parliament.
De Silguy said the Commission could confirm it's earlier prediction that growth in the 15-nation bloc would be around 2.3 percent this year.
"At the same time we note that the appreciation of the dollar (more than 10 percent above the average for 1996) constitutes a positive factor which could lead to raising this," he said.

"With the dollar at 1.75 deutschmarks, that is (a contribution of) around 0.3 to 0.4 percent (to gross domestic product growth) over three or so quarters...at 1.90 or 1.92 marks nobody knows what the effect would be," he said.
